name: var_weathered_limestone_side_1
what: the side of weathered limestone. A new variant of the attached texture (the last image before the grid, from my game): exactly the same colours, the same width and darkness of the vertical rain streaks, the same grey-green tinge, grain and light; only their arrangement differs, so this tile and the original side by side don't look like a repeat. Streaks continue across the top and bottom edges. Seamless on all four edges, every cell filled. Variant 1 of 3: a clearly different layout from the other variants.
